title: Phase 5 — Azure OpenAI gpt-live-transcribe come STT realtime primario (BLOCKED: deployment mancante)
body:
## Summary
Azure OpenAI `gpt-live-transcribe` becomes the default realtime STT for the Assistant's voice channel (Prompt 5, Azure).
- **Provider-independent STT.** `AI_STT_PROVIDER=azure_openai` is the default; the model/deployment is configurable. It uses the **same Azure OpenAI resource, endpoint and key** as the AI runtime. Gemini is explicit opt-in only, with no silent fallback.
- **Realtime WebRTC.** The browser connects to the Azure Realtime GA transcription session. ClinicOS proxies the SDP negotiation: `POST /skills/voice/realtime-call` reaches the runtime's `negotiate_call`, which mints the ephemeral client secret and uses it server-side. The browser receives only the SDP answer: no key, no token, and the CSP is unchanged.
- **Server transport.** The utterance path uses a server-side Realtime WebSocket on the same deployment.
- **Push-to-talk states.** New states REQUESTING_PERMISSION, TRANSCRIPT_PARTIAL and TRANSCRIPT_FINAL. **Partials are display-only and can never be sent.** The local VAD commits each turn, since the model has no server VAD; silence is never committed.
- **Health check.** `GET /skills/voice/health` is non-destructive and gives a clear diagnosis.
- **Azure failure** shows ERROR plus the text fallback; the text Assistant keeps working.

## Status: BLOCKED — do not merge as "verified"
The `gpt-live-transcribe` deployment **does not exist** in the Azure resource (DeploymentNotFound; health returns `deployment_missing`). The model is in the catalog (`gpt-live-transcribe-2026-07-28`).
- To unblock: deploy it in Foundry, then run `scripts/voice/azure-stt-check.mjs` and `scripts/voice/voice-realtime-e2e.mjs --mode azure`. See `.ai-architecture/phase-5-voice/PROMPT6_HANDOFF.md` §F.
- Voice stays OFF in every environment (`VOICE_CHANNEL_ENABLED`).

## Tests
- Runtime: Azure adapter 13 tests, full suite OK.
- Backend: skills + voice 47/47.
- Frontend: voice 27/27; full suite has 9 failures, all baseline.
- Browser, **mock** realtime transport (labelled): 34/34. Real mic VAD, backend, Agno, policy, DB and audit.
- Browser, **real Azure** failure path: 5/5.
- Text Assistant: 46/46.
- Backend full serial run: no new failing files.
- Azure-dependent check: **BLOCKED**.
- Independent QA: 3 rounds. Round 1 was FAILED VALIDATION (CSP, mic left on after an error); everything is fixed and the final verdict is READY FOR QA.

humanComments.body:
Codex sta riconciliando questa PR con l’architettura provider-neutral attuale, mantenendo il realtime esplicitamente opzionale e disattivato. Nessuna disponibilità attuale del deployment Azure è dedotta dal messaggio storico di questa PR.

La prima QA indipendente ha riprodotto un difetto: un errore anticipato del buffer chiudeva microfono e peer lasciando l’interfaccia in ascolto. Nel ciclo2/4 è stata applicata una correzione limitata a due file; il candidato passa48 verifiche browser,12 test backend e29 test voce frontend, oltre alla build. Una nuova sessione QA indipendente sta verificando il candidato congelato. Le prove della prima QA fallita sono conservate, non sovrascritte.

Non è ancora una richiesta di review Claude: dopo la QA Codex pubblicherà codice e prove sullo SHA esatto, aggiornando titolo e descrizione per riflettere l’implementazione finale. Nessuna attivazione voce, chiamata Azure reale, merge o risoluzione è dichiarata da questo aggiornamento.
